headline: Buy Amazon for the year: Morgan Stanley's new top pick leads Tuesday's board as GE and RTX beat and raise; Rays priced at 37.5¢ to win the World Series
top_call: Morgan Stanley's new top pick is Amazon, with a $350 target 33% above the price. Buy it for the year.
backdrop: Nasdaq 100 futures -0.3% and S&P 500 futures flat early Tuesday as chips slip again after Monday's rebound (Nasdaq +1.1%, S&P +0.4%); Brent crude is near $110 on Houthi attacks. GM, GE and RTX report before the bell, Netflix after.

finance.label: RTX
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Tue Oct 20 7:14 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Our read: RTX beat and lifted its 2026 EPS view to $7.65-7.75 on a record $340B backlog; shares are up ~1% premarket.
finance.risk: Defense and aerospace names have run hard into the print, so a beat-and-raise can still fade by the close.

finance.label: GM
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Tue Oct 20 7:13 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Our read: GM beat ($3.70 vs $3.63), raised its cash-flow guide $2B and added a $20B buyback; a ~5% drop looks overdone.
finance.risk: It narrowed rather than raised profit guidance and flagged $2B of commodity and DRAM costs; gap-downs can keep sliding.

finance.label: DDOG
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Tue Oct 20 5:20 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Bernstein upgrades Datadog to Outperform, PT $350 from $237, as AI labs' enterprise token use grew at least 50% q/q.
finance.risk: Shares have nearly doubled this year and jumped ~5% Monday on the call; software multiples are rate-sensitive.

finance.label: AAPL
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Tue Oct 20 7:13 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Our read: Loop Capital cuts Apple to Hold, PT $330 from $370, on iPhone ship cuts; it trades at a 5-year-high 36x P/E.
finance.risk: 25 of 43 analysts still rate it a Buy (LSEG), and Services or AI news could lift the stock instead.

finance.label: AMZN
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Tue Oct 20 7:14 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Morgan Stanley names Amazon a top pick, PT $350 from $335, on AWS growth (47% in 2027 est.), Bedrock and robotics.
finance.risk: AI capex and debt worries are hitting the group again, and AWS has to accelerate the way Morgan Stanley expects.

finance.label: GE
finance.entry_note: Yahoo Finance, Tue Oct 20 7:14 AM ET premarket
finance.why: Our read: GE Aerospace beat ($2.25 vs $2.00), orders jumped 49% and it raised 2026 EPS to $8.00-8.10; we buy the dip.
finance.risk: The Street already expected a raise; slower air traffic or engine supply problems could cool aftermarket demand.

ai.headline: OpenAI races to raise about $30B at a valuation above $1.4 trillion before Anthropic's mid-November IPO
ai.why: The two labs are chasing the same investors; OpenAI says it hit $50B in annualized revenue and wants to close before Anthropic's disclosures invite comparisons.

ai.headline: One hacker used AI agents to break into 100+ company sites, including Deere and SharkNinja, for about $50 a hack
ai.why: Agents ran the intrusions almost on their own from a few terse instructions: real evidence that attacks now scale with tokens, not people.

ai.headline: Korean AI data-centre firm Elice plunges 30% in its market debut
ai.why: Its IPO was priced before the AI selloff; with Firmus, AirTrunk and SB Energy listings shelved, the market now asks who pays for the buildout.

ai.headline: DHS bans DeepSeek from federal civilian agencies and future government purchases
ai.why: It's the first Chinese AI model named in a formal federal exclusion order, citing data sent to servers in China; agencies must also remove existing installs.

ai.headline: Microsoft rolls out controls that score each AI agent's risk and can block, pause or shut it down
ai.why: Companies are now treating agents as insiders with real system access, and the same week shows what agents can do in the wrong hands.

sports.label: Rays YES
sports.why: Rays won the ALCS 7-3 in Game 6; DraftKings' +135 series price is ~41% no-vig and ESPN's sims say 41%, vs 37.5¢ here.

sports.market: NBA opener: OKC @ SAS, Tue 9:30 PM ET
sports.why: Heavy action on OKC moved the line from +105 at open to -102 at DraftKings for the West finals rematch; Prop Professor backs the Thunder.

sports.why: The NY Post backs New England (+3.5), which rates better than Chicago by DVOA; bet365's +139 is ~40% no-vig vs 39.5¢.

sports.market: Week 7: GB @ DET, Sun Oct 25 4:25 PM ET
sports.why: The NY Post says Green Bay is far better than the market thinks, with Josh Jacobs expected back and a No. 8 DVOA defense.

sports.why: Golden State is without Porzingis, Butler and Moody; the line moved from -198 at open to -225 at DraftKings (~66% no-vig).
